definitions.gloss: communication ability, power to convey a message
definitions.explanation: The ability to effectively convey information, ideas, or feelings to others. Frequently used in business, education, and self-improvement contexts.

examples.japanese: {伝達力|でんたつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}めたい→高める：02065_takameru⟧。
examples.english: I want to improve my communication skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦プレゼン→プレゼン：05505_purezen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{伝達力|でんたつりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Communication ability is important in presentations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{伝達力|でんたつりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れていて→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧、⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧な⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦わかりやすく→わかりやすい：09582_wakariyasui⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}できる→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: She excels at communication and can explain complex topics in an easy-to-understand way.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{伝達|でんたつ}→伝達：11570_dentatsu⟧ (transmission, communication) + {力|りょく} (power, ability). Part of a productive pattern in Japanese where ～{力|りょく} is added to form "ability to do X" nouns.

Very common in business skills discussions, job descriptions, and self-improvement contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伝達力|でんたつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to improve communication ability
- {伝達力|でんたつりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have communication ability
- {伝達力|でんたつりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to excel in communication
- {伝達力|でんたつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish one's communication skills
